observations_not_elevated_to_findings.topic: RESERVED_DEVICE_NAME basename matching against Contract's literal text
observations_not_elevated_to_findings.note: A component such as 'com1 .json' (a reserved name immediately followed by a space then a dot) is not flagged as RESERVED_DEVICE_NAME by the current implementation, because the basename-before-first-dot ('com1 ', with a trailing space) does not case-insensitively equal 'COM1'. The implementation is a faithful, literal match to Contract #8.1's own wording ('componentの最初のdotより前をcase-insensitiveに比較したbasenameが...'). Whether real Windows/NTFS would itself treat this exact form as the reserved device is genuinely unclear and outside what Gate A's lexical-only primitive claims to guarantee (Contract #8.1 explicitly defers physical/OS-level edge cases). Not raised as a Finding because the implementation correctly follows the Contract as written; if Design Authority wants this tightened, it is a Contract-layer question, not a Production defect.
